robotstxt-desc: Serves robots.txt from the wiki, using the page MediaWiki:Robots.txt or generated default rules.
robotstxt-lint-intro: This text may not work as intended in a robots.txt file. You can still save it, but crawlers ignore lines they do not understand:
robotstxt-lint-nocolon: Line $1 has no colon, so crawlers ignore it: $2
robotstxt-lint-orphan: Line $1 is an Allow or Disallow rule that comes before the first User-agent line, so crawlers ignore it: $2
robotstxt-lint-path: Line $1: the value of an Allow or Disallow rule should start with / or *, otherwise it matches nothing: $2
